mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase and can potentiate colchicine's effects; colchicine has sympathomimetic properties that may be potentiated by MAOI activity, increasing risk of hypertensive crisis and cardiovascular complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use alternative agents such as NSAIDs or other anti-inflammatory agents with tranylcypromine, or consider alternative antidepressants with fewer MAOI properties.
